hero.title:
Drop one track.
Find [[what belongs next.]]
hero.platform: Resomix reveals a track's unique identity, subtle connections, and its place within a music catalogue.
hero.figureAria: One piece of music enters Resomix, PYXIS-1 builds a sonic profile from its five measurable dimensions, and three intelligences emerge: Sonic Discovery, Track Intelligence and Catalogue Intelligence

statement.head: Resomix brings the art of music selection into the age of algorithmic precision
statement.sub: Beyond charts, metadata and release date: discover and filter music by how it actually sounds.

products.head: One reference. Three different studies.
products.footnote: Powered by PYXIS-1 · 70+ measurable audio characteristics · results ranked by sound

sonic.name: Sonic Discovery
sonic.outcome: From one reference to a cohesive playlist in no time
sonic.description: Search a known track or upload a reference; PYXIS-1 returns ranked similar tracks you can audition. Your similarity playlist is created automatically.

track.name: Track Intelligence
track.outcome: A deep sonic analysis to understand what a track is made of.
track.description: BPM, key and Camelot, structure, energy journey, loudness, harmony, timbre, genre and mood, all read plainly, with confidence where available.

catalogue.name: Catalogue Intelligence
catalogue.outcome: Unleash the true power of your music catalogue.
catalogue.description: Explore the full potential of your catalogue, finding subtle relationships between tracks and uncovering those hidden gems that make it unique.

how.head: Start with a track.
how.step01: Search a public track or upload a reference
how.step01sub: Start from the catalogue, or drop your own audio.
how.tileSearchD: Type an artist or title, and use any result as your reference.
how.tileDropD: MP3, WAV, FLAC or AIFF. Processed privately, deleted no later than 24 hours after upload or analysis.
how.step02body: 70+ measurable audio characteristics, read from the recording itself.
how.step03sub: A similarity playlist, created automatically, so you can audition it track by track.
how.step04sub: Read structure, energy, harmony and character before you decide.

trackIntelligence.texture: Resomix reads the texture of your reference track: rhythm, harmony, energy and timbre.
trackIntelligence.body: See how a track builds, peaks and releases, so you'll know exactly where it fits before you play it.
trackIntelligence.figureAria: An explanatory Track Intelligence reading: the energy journey across one recording, its structural regions, a marked drop moment, and its key, tempo, loudness and style
trackIntelligence.reading: Slow build-up · peaks at the drop · clean release

catalogue.head: Your repertoire, discoverable by sound
catalogue.body: Older and underexposed recordings don't stop being relevant; they stop being found. Catalogue Intelligence helps you uncover them and see how they connect to the rest of your music catalogue, sound library, and more.
catalogue.item3: Search, compare and analyse your own recordings.
catalogue.figureAria: A private catalogue field with three sonic clusters, one brief entering the map, a focused set surfaced from the full catalogue, a dormant recording resurfacing, and human-review markers inside a partner boundary

api.head: One partner-scoped API
api.figureAria: Four stages: an authorised partner catalogue enters isolated Resomix processing, which is partner-scoped with no shared pool, runs Search, Similarity or Track Analysis against the private index, and returns a structured response delivered inside the partner's own product
api.s02d: Runs only against your private index.
api.s04d: Results delivered in your own product or workflow.
api.truth: No public sandbox. The guided pilot is the evaluation path.

audiences.eyebrow: Built for people who work in sound

djs.label: DJs
djs.outcome: Crate digging, enhanced: discover music beyond traditional boundaries.

producers.label: Producers
producers.outcome: Study how a reference is built, from structure and energy to texture.

curators.label: Curators
curators.outcome: Build playlists that flow by sound, not by titles and release dates.

labels.label: Labels & Distributors
labels.outcome: Turn your deep catalogue into a valuable revenue source.

platforms.label: Platforms & Music Tech
platforms.outcome: Add sound-first discovery through the API and the guided pilot.

trust.z1d: Uploaded source audio is deleted no later than 24 hours after upload or analysis. Never public. Never used to train or fine-tune PYXIS-1.
trust.z2d: Your saved work stays yours: retained for the service you asked for, deleted when you decide.
trust.z3d: Logically isolated, agreement-bound, restricted to authorised access. A production beta with its controls stated plainly.

final.head: You bring the vision. We surface the sound.
final.body: Resomix maps the measurable character of a track and surfaces its closest sonic relationships, no matter who released it or when. That's what discovery should be.
final.fork1d: Start with a track: search the catalogue or upload a reference, then audition a ranked shortlist in minutes.
final.fork2d: Test Resomix on your own authorised catalogue: a guided pilot, scored against criteria you agree first.
